steps.en: The work item is routed to the 2OIC
steps.why_en: Work is assigned to the same officer, no 2OIC role exists, and nothing receives it.
steps.why_id: Pekerjaan dialokasikan ke officer yang sama, peran 2OIC tidak ada, dan tidak ada yang menerimanya.

steps.en: The 2OIC sees the decisions awaiting endorsement
steps.why_en: The page exists, but in deployed builds the list is never loaded or shown.
steps.why_id: Halamannya ada, tapi di build yang sudah deploy daftarnya tidak pernah dimuat atau tampil.

steps.en: The 2OIC reviews the decision with the offence details and history
steps.id: 2OIC meninjau keputusan beserta detail pelanggaran dan riwayat
steps.why_en: Decision details are shown, but the offender's past offences are not.
steps.why_id: Detail keputusan tampil, tapi riwayat pelanggaran offender tidak.

steps.en: The 2OIC endorses or rejects the decision
steps.why_en: The approve or reject form exists, but nothing in the system processes the answer.
steps.why_id: Formulir setuju atau tolak ada, tapi tidak ada sistem yang memproses jawabannya.
